answer: Because the horizon decay is applied at each close, the island audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 30% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the meadow fee to keep them eligible. A 354 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
